caption: The drawing features a rectangular area filled with a textured medium blue background, located centrally on a plain off-white or cream-colored page. Within the blue rectangle are three stylized leaves: the leftmost leaf is yellow-beige with a dark blue vein and smaller leaf-like shapes, the central leaf is medium green with a similar dark blue vein and marks, and the bottom leaf is lighter green with the same kind of vein and smaller leaf details. All three leaves have additional slender green stems and smaller leaf motifs sprouting outward, rendered in blue and green. The surrounding area outside the blue rectangle is blank except for a faint handwritten inscription in the bottom right corner.
title: Skirt Design
